thingsToDo: Start with a count of 10 (the `initialCount` prop) and not liked.
Clicking the button toggles the liked state; liked adds 1 to the count.
Clicking again removes the like, so the count goes back down.
Give the button the class `liked` while it is liked.

instructions.intro: Add these `data-testid` attributes to the matching elements in your solution so the **Submit** checks can verify it:

files.styles.css:
.like { padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; }
.like.liked { background: #fff1f2; border-color: #fda4af; color: #e11d48; }

tests.name: Clicking likes it: count becomes 11 and the button is `liked`
Clicking again unlikes it: count goes back to 10
